description: A great ZEISS zoom for full frame bodies This compact zoom lens can bring out the best in full frame E-mount cameras in a wide range of day-to-day shooting situations. A constant F4 maximum aperture enables consistent exposure settings throughout the 24 mm to 70 mm zoom range, while ZEISS optics with the acclaimed T* coating deliver outstanding clarity and beautiful rendering. It is dust/moisture resistant too. A versatile zoom for everyday shooting The optical performance and 24 mm to 70 mm range of this ZEISS Vario-Tessar® are a perfect match for α7 series bodies, maximising both image quality and shooting versatility. Refined optics deliver stunning images Aspherical and ED optical elements add up to superior corner-to-corner performance with low distortion and minimal colour aberration. T* coating minimises flare and ghosting. Constant exposure at any zoom setting Maximum aperture is F4 at all focal lengths so the user can zoom and shoot at any aperture without having to keep track of changes in exposure settings or depth of field.
